notes.title: Version 0.3.0
notes.content:
Version 0.3.0 - 08/29/25
========================

GM Module Features:
-------------------
- New Map Type: World Maps
  - Able to travel between worlds, dungeons, or within same world map
- Widgets that show static map images can now be zoomed / panned

GM Module Bug Fixes/Improvements:
---------------------------------
- Reworked Map Link system
  - Fixed intermap linking
- Double clicking Map Links can be used to initiate travel
- Importing maps/campaigns that are duplicates will append an iteration number
- Campaign Editor dialog a little more streamlined
- Campaign Editor moved as a dialog to main menu
- Close Main Menu after clicking on a menu item (GM Game Window)
- Backup Campaign on save
- Fix light effect edit pull-down not updating when changing light type

Core Bug Fixes/Improvements:
----------------------------
- Improved file migrations to future versions
- Players are sprinkled around destinations when travelling instead of lining
  up the tokens
- Improved map transitions

notes.title: Version 0.2.0
notes.content:
Version 0.2.0 - 07/11/25
========================

GM Module Features:
-------------------
- Lights have been converted to a new Component type
- New Component System:
  - Can drag and drop Components onto Tokens (snaps to)
  - Can remove Components from Tokens via the Token Editor
  - Tokens can attach a max of 1 Light Component
  Note: Currently this only applies to light.
- New Token Object Type
  - Token Objects can be picked/dropped up by Players/NPCs via the right-click
    context menu or by drag-and-drop
    - Token Object must be near Player/NPC (~2 tiles)
	Note: Currently only 1 Token Object can be carried at a time by a Player/NPC
- Annotation Image presentations visible to connected Clients
- Initial Campaign Settings (accessible from Sidebar->Other tab)
  - Currently only one Campaign Setting: Global Torch Timers
- Light Type vs. Light Effect
  - There are now 3 Light Types that no longer dictate the light effect
  - Light Types: Constant, Timed Torch, Timed Lantern
  - Light Effects: None, Torch Flicker
- Timed Light Sources are now simplified and automatic
- Light Effect setting is now separated from the Light type
- Timed Light Sources or Token Objects with attached Timed Light Sources can be
  "Extinguished" or "Ignited" via the right-click context menu
- Global Torch Timers
  - Global Torch Timers setting can be toggled to use 1 Global Torch Timer for
    all Timed Light Sources (including connected Clients)
  - If a Global Torch Timer is active, a UI count-down is displayed in
    bottom-left
- "Lights Out!" button to extinguish all running Timed Light Sources

GM Module Bug Fixes/Improvements:
---------------------------------
- Campaign list sorted alphabetically
- Campaign Map list sorted alphabetically

Core Bug Fixes/Improvements:
----------------------------
- Improved multiplayer synchronization (new multiplayer authority management)
  - Fix missing Player Token images if Client connects after a Player Token has
    been assigned
- Fix Token Shader effect change being synchronized
- New UI Artwork (doors, lights, dead marker)
- Introduction of this changelog (deployed with build)

Core Bug Fixes/Improvements:
----------------------------
- Dead Token icon is now rendered by lighting and line-of-sight (no more ghostly
  floating skulls in the void)
- Client Players can pick up and drop Token Objects (e.g. Torches) via
  right-click context menu if Token Object is within range
